description: This file defines a static internal class 'DirectoryInstruments' which initializes various performance counters, histograms, and observable gauges related to directory lookup operations, cache states, and network transfer metrics within the Orleans runtime. It primarily sets up instrumentation for monitoring and diagnostics.

classes.name: DirectoryInstruments
classes.description: A static class for defining and registering various performance instrumentation instruments for directory operations in Orleans.

methods.name: RegisterDirectoryPartitionSizeObserve
methods.description: Registers an observable gauge for directory partition size.

methods.name: RegisterCacheSizeObserve
methods.description: Registers an observable gauge for cache size.

methods.name: RegisterRingSizeObserve
methods.description: Registers an observable gauge for ring size.

methods.name: RegisterMyPortionRingDistanceObserve
methods.description: Registers an observable gauge for the distance of this node's ring portion.

methods.name: RegisterMyPortionRingPercentageObserve
methods.description: Registers an observable gauge for this node’s ring portion percentage.

methods.name: RegisterMyPortionAverageRingPercentageObserve
methods.description: Registers an observable gauge for average ring portion percentage.
